rationale: Idempotence and monotonicity follow by case analysis on the two `if` branches plus omega; the int32 bound reuses result_in_bounds_proof. Only the editable proof file changes.

import Spec

/-!
Editable Lean proofs (may be written / repaired by the AI).  Each `*_proof`
constant must prove the statement of the same name in `lean/Spec.lean`.
Shipped with `sorry` placeholders: the `lean` gate reports every theorem as
unproved until real proofs are supplied.
-/

namespace LeanClamp.Proofs
open LeanClamp

theorem result_in_bounds_proof : result_in_bounds := by
  intro x lo hi r h
  unfold clamp at h
  split at h
  · contradiction
  · cases h; omega

theorem error_iff_empty_range_proof : error_iff_empty_range := by
  intro x lo hi
  unfold clamp
  split <;> simp_all

theorem identity_in_range_proof : identity_in_range := by
  intro x lo hi h1 h2
  unfold clamp
  split
  · omega
  · congr 1; omega

theorem idempotent_proof : idempotent := by
  intro x lo hi r h
  unfold clamp at h ⊢
  split at h
  · contradiction
  · cases h
    split
    · omega
    · congr 1; omega

theorem monotone_proof : monotone := by
  intro x y lo hi rx ry hxy hx hy
  unfold clamp at hx hy
  split at hx
  · contradiction
  · split at hy
    · contradiction
    · cases hx; cases hy; omega

theorem result_fits_int32_proof : result_fits_int32 := by
  intro x lo hi r hlo hhi h
  have := result_in_bounds_proof x lo hi r h
  unfold INT32_MIN INT32_MAX at *
  omega

end LeanClamp.Proofs
